title: tephrosia nubica subsp. arabica
intro: Tephrosia nubica subsp. arabica, commonly known as White Heartleaf, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tephrosia nubica subsp. arabica include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various diseases such as malaria and fever. The bioactive constituents of the plant include isoflavones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
